Main Case No: Crl.R.C.No.288 of 2011
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Date Order

J  The petitioner has suffered the concurrent  conviction for the alleged offence under Section 376  of 'the IPC', but the petitioner has not arrayed the  de-facto complainant as respondent No.2 as per the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jagjeet Singh and others v. Ashish Mishra1.
Therefore, the learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to implead the de-facto complainant on record as respondent No.2 and cause serve notice on the de-facto complainant and file proof to that effect.
Post the matter after two (02) months.
_________
